description.value: Moodswing Coffee + Bar is a plant-forward café and cocktail dive bar in New Westminster's historic Front Street mews, operating on the unceded territories of the Qayqayt and Musqueam nations, formerly known as Old Crow Coffee Co. It has evolved into a lively community hub with a creative cocktail list, plant-based tacos and snacks, and a packed roster of free events including open mics, vinyl DJ nights, and themed cocktail evenings. The intimate historic-building space is a distinctive stop for a cyclist looking for a full meal, a craft drink, and an authentic neighbourhood vibe.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 52m; stands at 64m; rack at 94m; rack at 100m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at moodswingbar.com confirms an active café and cocktail bar at 655 Front Street, New Westminster, with a current events calendar (May 2026) and full menus, establishing it as a real, open business. The contact page explicitly documents onsite non-gendered washrooms (1 toilet, 1 sink) and detailed accessibility notes, supporting value=true for Washrooms. The bar/food menu is described as entirely plant-forward with explicit attention to all dietary restrictions, supporting value=true for Vegetarian/vegan/GF; bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, and takeout are not mentioned in website content so remain null despite the OSM internet_access=wlan tag.
concerns: OSM hours (Mon–Thu 09:00–16:00, Fri–Sun 09:00–17:00) differ significantly from website hours (Mon–Tue closed, Wed–Sun 8am–3pm or 8am–11pm); OSM hours appear outdated.

Contact email addresses on the website (info@oldcrowcoffeeco.com, howdy@oldcrowcoffeeco.com, moody@oldcrowcoffeeco.com) use the former business name Old Crow Coffee Co. and may or may not still be active.
OSM name 'Moodswing' is a truncation of the website's full name 'Moodswing Coffee + Bar'.
OSM tag internet_access=wlan not confirmed by website content; treated as null per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible café and bar with confirmed address, current events, and full menu.
enrichment_extras.notes: Accessibility is well-documented on the contact page: 32-inch front door clearance with a small lip, accessible parking in front loading zone, ample interior wheelchair space, booth seating not wheelchair-friendly but staff provide accessible seating on request.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'All of our food is plant-forward and we make a concerted effort to offer nourishment to all dietary restrictions.' Full menu is plant-based; allergen cross-contamination caveat noted

wow_evidence: plant-forward café and cocktail dive bar in New Westminster's historic Front Street mews... onsite non-gendered washrooms
